title: chore: designate the six CQ epics' integration-and-hardening tasks with update_epic finalTaskId
description:
Board data only; no code changes. task-cd2e447728224044abe7fa669d42f7fb adds Epic.finalTaskId and makes get_context isEpicFinal follow it. No structural rule can pick CQ-F12 on its own, because bc8410af depends on F12 and was created after it, so the six CQ epics need an explicit designation.

This project's live daemon runs the IDE-bundled build. That build rejects finalTaskId until the plugin is rebuilt from a commit that contains task-cd2e447728224044abe7fa669d42f7fb and the daemon restarts. Promote this row only after that. Probe with one moe.update_epic call first: an "is not a supported epic update field" error means the daemon is still on the old build.

Designate:
- CQ-F epic-5d9f6c0a3b0a4a6882d2a74387a3f56d -> task-72184c6505cc41e8b6066732011ffb70 [CQ-F12]
- CQ-R epic-fe5e32c32b044a20944c693dfd79411b -> task-f4811a729f9e436ba129a65c12d348c1 [CQ-R13]
- CQ-V epic-f5c1c2ea674e40bcad8ab16d7657ccc0 -> task-b621ddc99fe44d50ab700b2aa51c84fc [CQ-V12]
- CQ-C epic-9d76d843b4ec484987139b930d1d681e -> task-4e0264fc52e04574a9d10ef602281ca3 [CQ-C11]
- CQ-I epic-c9561bfb767248e38c9c0be82d09ec2c -> task-4e412148225f480c8c0d5a1706a3cc76 [CQ-I06]
- CQ-M epic-b8c6bbda4def46cbb8d1b351f8ea3eeb -> task-ced857485a1c4d75b57cc25dcc9b4d82 [CQ-M06]

Go through moe.update_epic only. Never edit .moe/epics/*.json by hand.
definitionOfDone: moe.update_epic { epicId, finalTaskId } has been called through the daemon for each of the six CQ epics, with the hardening task listed in the description, and no .moe/ file was edited by hand.

moe.get_context reports isEpicFinal true for F12, R13, V12, C11, I06 and M06, and false for each epic's highest-order non-ARCHIVED sibling at the time of the check. The six F12/R13/V12/C11/I06/M06 get_context outputs and the sibling checks are supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: Human-gated: promote only after the daemon serving this project runs a build that contains task-cd2e447728224044abe7fa669d42f7fb (moe.update_epic accepts finalTaskId).
